events.title: Dev Diary #4: The Demo Is Out. What Comes Next?
events.summary: The demo has been out for a few weeks now. The launch went well, and I'm really happy to have reached this point. Thank you to everyone who has tried Imperium of the Stars and sent feedback.After all the time spent working on it, it feels good to finally have people playing. Still a lot to do. But getting the demo out was a big step. Now Steam Next Fest is starting, so I'm looking forward to more people trying the game. events.title: The demo is out
events.summary: The Imperium of the Stars demo is out on Steam. You can play the first 50 in-game years as the Imperium.You’ll start as the routes to long-isolated worlds reopen. From there, it’s your campaign: decide which worlds to bring back, what they need, and where to send your fleets. The demo includes Era I research and uses the Balanced Game Director. It ends after 50 years.If you play, I’d like to hear how it went. I’m especially interested in anything that was confusing, frustrating, or hard to find.

events.title: Dev Diary #3: A Living Galaxy
events.summary: It has been a while since the last dev diary. With Steam Next Fest getting closer, I wanted to talk a bit more about what happens inside the empire you are building.Imperium of the Stars is a Gothic real-time 4X about reclaiming lost worlds and governing an expanding realm. You build your economy, command fleets, and fight over territory. events.title: Dev Diary #2 — Imperium Court
events.summary: The Imperium is the main faction in Imperium of the Stars. It will be most likely the one you will be playing first, and this the one other factions will be compared to. It also has the most politics in the game. It is basically a feudal empire, with the Throne at the centre. The CourtThe court has twelve seats: four Great Officers and eight Officers of the Realm. events.summary: This is the first dev diary. Posting one every two weeks from now on.Imperium of the Stars is a 4X grand strategy game that I've been building solo.
